title: Release
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/dispatches/<dispatch_id>/release, application/json: the adapter that serves the node pool gives the run back, why, and whether the run should wait for another claim. After the dispatch ended because its work item was closed or undone, it is refused, 410 gone. It is signed with the adapter's access key as https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

reason.description: Why the adapter gives the run back, display text, 1 to 200 characters.

retry.description: true when the run should wait for another claim; false when it should not.
